title: Annual torchlight procession commemorating the Armenian Genocide
reason: No evidence found that the gathering made a demand to Armenia’s own government or state policy; monitored and contemporaneous descriptions characterize it as a memorial commemoration.
notes: A1+ reports about 6,800 marchers, while Public Radio of Armenia search output describes a march of thousands from Freedom Square to the Tsitsernakaberd Memorial. It is excluded for lack of a qualifying own-state demand, not for lack of size.
